title: Brie Quesadilla Delight
description: A creamy and spicy twist on the classic quesadilla with melted brie cheese.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place the quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle the crumbled brie cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add the sliced spicy peppers on top of the brie cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve immediately with salsa or sour cream, if desired.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of salt.
